meta.title: KEEP SEVEN — asset manifest
meta.units: m, game space (+Y up, -Z forward). placeholder.size, offset, nodePos and hitPoint are [x, y, z]; asset-local axes: +Z is the asset's front, +Y up.

priority.0: on the critical path and seen within 5 m, or load-bearing for a puzzle, a fight or the story. Final before any P1 work starts.
priority.1: on the path but not load-bearing: a placeholder here is noticed but breaks nothing.
priority.2: dressing, secrets and polish clips (GDD 20.1 cut order). A P2 clip may ship as its `fallback` clip under its own name.

placedBy.origin: authored in world coordinates; loaded with its set and added at identity
placedBy.zone: imported, lit in place and merged into its zone GLB by the zone script; never loaded on its own at runtime
placedBy.layout: instantiated at runtime by src/world from design/layout.json markers through `bindings`
placedBy.dressing: instantiated at runtime from `inst_*` / `brk_*` empties in a zone GLB (instanced)
placedBy.code: spawned by a system (enemies, projectiles, view-model, lift shaft, cards)

placeholderAnchor.base: pivot at the centre of the bottom face; the asset stands on a surface
placeholderAnchor.sill: pivot at the centre of the bottom face; the asset is mounted in an opening
placeholderAnchor.top: pivot at the centre of the top face
placeholderAnchor.back: pivot at the centre of the back (-Z) face
placeholderAnchor.back_base: pivot at the middle of the bottom edge of the back face
placeholderAnchor.hinge: pivot at the bottom of the -X edge, mid thickness

env_the_lip.notes: Overhang, gully, gate piers, dead pylon. chunk_lip_rock is every rock face more than 3 m above the path, the overhang roof and the pylon mast above 3 m (vertex-lit): it is the skyline seen from the street and the yard. collider_terrain replaces the layout solids of role "terrain" (must stay within 0.25 m of them).

env_plenty_street.notes: Front Street (east and west halves split at x = -37, the gate court belongs to the west half) and the pump yard. chunk_st_works is the yard's tall machinery: the whole drum, the wind-pump derrick and the tank on its stilts with deck and ramp (the skyline seen down the street and from the jug gate). chunk_st_yard is the yard ground, walls, stubs, shed, cart and the Tally House exterior. pump_rotor is spun by code at 9 deg/s. drum_lamp is the aqua status lamp by the drum door. plug_door_tally is a black panel filling the Tally House doorway just inside the leaf (m_frontier, COLOR_0 black): world shows it while the door is open and the hall interior is not drawn.

rim_town_card.notes: Authored in world coordinates: the town (about 104 x 25 m) is drawn 12.5 m east of the layout vista_plenty target, 117 to 142 m from the ledge, and one leaning dead line pylon stands as a card 42 m out from the ledge at game (-0.9, 3.2 to 25, 61) (polish round 4; the size field is the town alone). 48 panes and 16 window pools (a second face of the same lamp). town_windows lights the first `lamps` quads (lighting order spreads outward from the Tally House).

env_backdrop_day.notes: Mesa cards, pylon line, cloud cards. One mesh, one draw call. Drawn with fog. socket_dowser is on the bearing of layout vista_dowser (due west of the yard).

env_backdrop_dusk.notes: Mesa cards, pylon line, the flat and the last fire's socket; since polish round 5 it also carries the wings of the rim's own cliff (26 m west and 33 m east of the ledge: the zone's chunk may not leave its box, this card may) and the rock under the ledge's two ends. One mesh, one draw call, unlit.

env_tally_house.notes: strip_hatch and the lm_tally_hatch light layer switch on with hatch_powered. The eleven chairs, the latch block and its cowl (layout ty_latch_*), and the pictogram plate on the west-wall conduit are zone geometry.

env_the_gallery.notes: Peg stair, proving bay, gallery. chunk_gl_stair holds the seam (flight 1, landing 1 and their shaft walls) and is drawn while the surface set is resident once the hatch is powered. The 3.6 m gallery module is baked once and copied by the script (shared lightmap UVs), then merged: no instancing. Stair strips are baked lit.

env_lift_hall.notes: Includes the ramp-foot switchgear cabinet (layout lh_ramp_cabinet), the cage bay and the cold bay.

env_lift_shaft.notes: Dark-ride shell shown round the player during both lift rides (scaled to the cage in use); code scrolls the six lamp bars upward. Nothing else is drawn during a ride.

env_the_bore.notes: chunk_bo_ante is the antechamber and the stair down to it; chunk_bo_chamber is everything south of the door wall (arrival bay, catwalk, chamber, bore shaft, proving-lift room). The chamber is one 60 degree sector baked once and copied five times about bore_axis by the script (shared lightmap UVs, copied vertex light), then merged into chunk_bo_chamber: no instancing; the triangle budget counts all six. mark_glows = the six proving marks (index = bay - 1). bore_glow participates in wrong_fade. The kerb is 0.6 m high in a 35 degree notch in front of each mark and 1.2 m at the six merlons (layout bo_kerb, bo_kerb_hi_*).

prop_cartridge_kept.notes: round_violet is ia_stone_round (runtime, taken by the player); six round_spent are zone-baked on the rim stone.

ia_jug.notes: The jug body (0.42 m) hangs 0.6 m below the pivot: body centre 0.81 m below it. Layout jug markers are body centres (the hit sphere); the binding offset puts the pivot on the hook.

prop_stock_gate.pivot: bottom centre of the hurdle, closed
prop_stock_gate.notes: Sized to door_jug_gate (4 x 2.8 m): bar 4.6 m, hurdle 3.9 x 2.35 m. hook_n are children of gate_bar, on the face away from the street (asset -Z), 0.7 m apart. Jugs and their hit spheres follow the hooks as code raises gate_bar.

prop_well_sweep.pivot: world origin (authored in place: post beside the gate, arm tip at layout prop_pylon.sweepTo)

ia_yard_door.notes: socket_knot is on the street face (asset -Z), 1.3 m up and 0.95 m from the door centre toward the latch edge: where layout knot_yard_latch sits.

knot_mech.notes: Used for knot_yard_latch, knot_hatch_latch, knot_cold_bay and knot_a/b/c (scale 1.25). The knot centre (the layout marker, the hit sphere) is 0.08 m in front of the pivot.

prop_camp_ash.notes: ash_embers is stop three only (the bore antechamber). ash_cold is the town's ash in the Tally House firebox. Not used at stop one.

prop_chair.notes: Eleven copies are merged into env_tally_house by the zone script (no instancing).

ia_shutter.pivot: hinge axis centre (bottom edge of the leaf)
ia_shutter.notes: The pivot is 0.45 m below the opening centre (the shutter_* marker); latch is the white insulator 0.55 m below the pivot and 0.06 m proud of the wall: exactly the ia_latch_* marker.

prop_day_cell.notes: The pictogram plate is not on this asset: it is zone geometry of env_tally_house (layout prop_daycell_plate).

ia_hatch.notes: Rectangular, two leaves sliding apart. `open` is linear in time: code holds it at 15 % for the "ajar" state (0.3 m gap, still impassable). socket_knot marks layout knot_hatch_latch; the latch block and its cowl are zone geometry of env_tally_house.

ia_range_plate.notes: A disc 0.7 m across whose centre hangs 0.45 m below the hook. Collision is the pierce-tagged layout solid ia_range_plate_n_solid.

prop_proving_step.notes: Collision is the layout solid gl_mark_step.

ia_baffle.notes: The lamp bar mounts on the wall above the lintel, outside the leaf area.

prop_door_pellam.notes: The gallery far door only. The yard drum door is zone geometry of env_plenty_street.

ia_cold_bay_shutter.notes: Collider is tagged pierce. socket_knot marks layout knot_cold_bay (seen through the inspection slot beside the shutter).

ia_lift_cage.notes: The hall lift cage, interior 6 x 3.5 x 6 m (w x h x d, from nav.portals ride_lift_hall). The gate fills the whole +Z side. Two instances: lift_depart_hall and lift_arrival_bore (the same cage turned half a turn). The box collider is the gate only; cage walls are layout solids.

ia_proving_lift_cage.notes: The proving lift cage, interior 4 x 3.5 x 4 m (from nav.portals ride_proving_lift), a 3 x 3 m gate on the +Z side. control is the call plate on the back wall (layout ia_proving_lift). Built from the same parts as ia_lift_cage (1.2 m module), not scaled from it. Two instances: lift_depart_bore, lift_arrival_rim.

ia_bore_door.notes: port_n are empties at the socket centres on the antechamber face (asset +Z), on a 1.0 m ring, numbered clockwise from the top as seen from the antechamber. listen_lamps fill clockwise from the top.

ia_cradle.notes: Load-bearing. mark_lamps index 6 (the seventh disc) is dark until the proof.

ia_proving_mark.notes: Embedded in the bore sector by the zone script; its glow is lamp set mark_glows on env_the_bore.

weapon_revolver.pivot: camera (authored in camera space, barrel toward -Z)
weapon_revolver.notes: muzzle, eject, cam_look are empties. round_n and kept_loop are scaled by code (no clip may key them).

enemy_bider.notes: Faces +Z. Root motion is baked out of every clip (code moves it). crown and hand_socket_r are empties.

proj_stake.notes: Shared pool: 8 in flight + 18 stuck (Transits and the Windlass).

enemy_tamper.notes: State line_stagger (GDD 7.3 revision 2) plays `stagger` at half speed while code holds vent_chest and vent_back open: both vent bones must be openable additively over any clip (key them only in stagger, charge_stun and die).

boss_windlass.pivot: bore axis at chamber floor level, arm heading +Z at yaw 0
boss_windlass.notes: One rigid-skinned body mesh (body_mesh) plus two lamp-set meshes: 3 draw calls. boss_lamps indices: 0-5 mouth lamps 1-6, 6-11 knot cores 1-6, 12 pawl_l core, 13 pawl_r core. gauge indices 0-25 = pips (10, 10, 6). mouth_open / mouth_close are authored on mouth_1 and retargeted by code; idle_sway keys root only.

tx_frontier_trim.notes: Region `flat` is a uniform 0.5 grey cell: embedded props and far scenery merged into a zone chunk point UV0 at it and carry their palette colour in COLOR_0, so they need no material of their own.

tx_pellam_trim.notes: Region `flat` is a uniform 0.5 grey cell: embedded props and far scenery merged into a zone chunk point UV0 at it and carry their palette colour in COLOR_0, so they need no material of their own.

tx_mask.notes: Alpha-test 0.5 on the red channel. grille and louvre tile; give them their own UV island with repeat handled in geometry.

tx_palette.notes: Built for real by the foundation pipeline in phase 2; props_dress owns later revisions. Pass i2: rows 6 to 15 (y 96..255) are no longer free: they hold the cloth atlas (blender/tex/cloth_atlas.py) with regions hood (0,96,256,80), coat (0,176,160,80), sleeve (160,176,48,80), weave (208,176,48,80); an m_prop UV0 is a cell centre, a point in a cloth region OR a point in a knot region. Pass i3: columns 10 to 15 of rows 2 to 5 (x 160..255, y 32..95) hold the knot atlas (blender/tex/knot_atlas.py): knot (160,32,64,64), knot_dead (224,32,32,32), cord (224,64,32,16), cord_dead (224,80,32,16); never name a cell past column 9 in rows 2 to 5. Append-only, like the cells.

tx_palette_emis.notes: Built for real by the foundation pipeline in phase 2; props_dress owns later revisions. Pass i3: no longer black except eight cells: the knot block (x 160..255, y 32..95) holds the light in the glass of the townspeople's knot (blender/tex/knot_atlas.py); the dead regions are black.

tx_gun_detail.notes: R14. One channel in tx_gun's UV layout: surface detail of the revolver (height: engraving, knurling, screw slots, pitting, edge wear), 0.5 = flat. The shader turns it into a bump and a cavity term.

tx_hands.notes: R14. RGB albedo of the hands and forearms (a glove or skin, cuff, seams), A = gloss mask. UV0 of the meshes that use m_hands.

tx_hands_detail.notes: R14. One channel in tx_hands' UV layout: height (stitching, creases, knuckles, grain), 0.5 = flat.

tx_fx.notes: Row A: four 256 px cells; rows B-C: sixteen 128 px cells (ART_BIBLE 9.1). Drawn by script with sharp; premultiplied alpha.

lm_surface.notes: Shared by env_the_lip and env_plenty_street (exterior). One bake scene holds both zones.

lm_tally_hatch.notes: Greyscale aqua up-light from the open hatch; same UV1 as lm_tally; tinted aqua and faded in by weight (hatch_powered).

lm_bore.notes: Fill layer: six aqua bay lamps, embers, cradle lamp, AO. No bore light in this layer.

lm_bore_glow.notes: Greyscale light from the bore alone; tinted violet -> aqua by wrong_fade (bottom-up by world height).

min.notes: Hidden emergency tier: no composer; Neutral tone map + grade inlined into every material through CustomToneMapping; context MSAA when the context was created for this tier (boot or ?tier=min), none after a runtime demotion.

targets.name: scene depth, one per scene buffer
bloom mip chain, 5 levels down and up

cells.why: The overhang and the four reaches down to the forecourt. The 12 to 22 m gully walls hide the town: only the tops of the first facades show over the gate wall.

accept.why: the yard floor and walls can be glimpsed only through door_yard_gate and ia_yard_door together, 80 m or more away (both are shut the first time she stands here); the yard skyline (drum, wind-pump, tank) is chunk_st_works and is drawn

cells.why: The forecourt: the whole street is seen through the jug gate, and the gully back up to the overhang.

accept.why: a sliver through door_alley and door_tally: the doorway shows plug_door_tally

cells.why: Front Street and the gate court. Of the lip only the skyline rock, the gate wall, the forecourt and the last reach can be seen (the blockout rays reach nothing above z = 30 at path level).

showIf.why: door_tally opens only after the sighting, which needs enc_yard clear
the east half of the street (60 m off: about 1 % of the blockout rays from this strip reach it, through both gateways) is traded for the hall interior at the moment the door opens

cells.why: The 12 m strip in front of the Tally House door: the only place the hall interior is drawn from outside.

accept.why: from the rest of the yard the open Tally House door is a dark doorway: plug_door_tally

showIf.why: the staged gallery stair (it is what she stands on)

cells.why: Peg-stair flight 1, landing 1 and the top of flight 2 while the surface set is resident (zoneAt gives tally_house here until trg_set_swap).

showIf.why: door_tally opens only after enc_yard is clear and the sighting is over, and enc_tally locks it again
ajar or open: the stair shows through the gap

accept.why: 3 of 5 040 blockout rays reach the gatehouse roof over the yard wall through the 1.6 m door

cells.why: The peg stair after the swap. The hatch above is shut; the bay shows at the foot of flight 3.

showIf.why: wave B of enc_file opens it and it stays open until trg_enc_matador
the gallery seen back through the far door from the gantry

cells.why: The lift hall, gantry, cage bay and cold bay. During a ride only env_lift_shaft and the cage are drawn.
Arrival bay, catwalk, antechamber and chamber: the catwalk looks into the chamber through its grille.

stages.when: boot, or a restore to a surface checkpoint before hatch_powered
trg_set_swap until the proving lift ride
